texts.preamble: Sunil Mewada vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 30 July, 2025 Author: Dinesh Kumar Paliwal Bench: Dinesh Kumar Paliwal 1 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur Crr No. 3254 of 2025 (Sunil Mewada Vs The State Of Madhya Prade Dated : 30-07-2025 Shri Manish Kumar Tiwari - Advocate for the applicant. Smt. Geeta Yadav - G.A. for the respondent/State.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant has referred para 52 of the appellate Court judgement and has submitted that analyst report Exhibit P/14 was not supplied to the accused in compliance of Rule 2.4.2:6 as such he has been deprived of his valuable right. It is submitted that learned trial Court has concluded that said report was not supplied to it. Therefore, the conviction recorded by the learned trial Court and affirmed by the appellate Court are erroneous and he has fair chances to succeed in the revision. It is further submitted that he has already suffered almost 20 days in jail. Therefore, he has prayed to suspend the jail sentence and grant of bail. On the other hand, learned counsel appearing for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant and has submitted that there is concurrent finding of fact and there is no illegality, incorrectness or impropriety in the judgment of conviction and order of sentence by the Courts below.
